# Week 3 — Visual QA log

**Source:** `docs/pptx/week-3-platform-training.pptx` (32 slides, regenerated by `scripts/build_pptx_week_3.py`)

## Method
1. `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` → PDF
2. `pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80` → one JPEG per defect/sanity slide
3. Walked the flagged content slides and sampled the cover and a non-defect content slide for regressions.

## Defects found and fixed in `scripts/build_pptx_week_3.py`
- **Two-line content titles overflowed the gold rule and the cards below.** Slides 8 ("Use the highest-trust tool your data allows.") and 25 ("Did your mode choice survive contact with the build?") used `render_content` with a fixed `next_y += 1.05` advance, so a 2-line H1 pushed the rule, the column eyebrows, and the cards into the title. **Fix:** added `estimate_visible_lines(text, box_w_in, font_size_pt)` (matches the Week 6 pattern with `char_w = 0.62 * pt / 72`); `render_content` now sizes the H1 box as `max(0.85, line_h * lines + 0.20)` and advances `next_y` by `head_h + 0.10` before drawing the rule and the body region underneath.

## Verified after fix
- Slide 1 (cover): unchanged (no overflow on the cover) — sanity-checked, renders identically.
- Slide 8 ("Use the highest-trust tool…"): 2-line title sits above the rule; both CAC-ENABLED / COMMERCIAL columns are clear.
- Slide 25 ("Did your mode choice survive contact with the build?"): 2-line title sits above the rule; the "Look back / Look forward" cards are clear.
- Slide 30 ("Four things between now and Week 4."): single-line title unchanged, bullets clear — no regression from the helper changes.

## How to re-run the QA
```sh
uv run python3 scripts/build_pptx_week_3.py
soffice --headless -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/sof-3 \
  --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/qa-week3 docs/pptx/week-3-platform-training.pptx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80 /tmp/qa-week3/week-3-platform-training.pdf /tmp/qa-week3/slide
```
